description: Returns the written questions of members to the bodies of the state, newest first: by a text of the request, by the member (a family name, ხორგუანი), or by a period of registration. Each question has its addressee, deadline, response date, and status: answered, pending, or overdue. The texts of a question and an answer are PDF files on its page. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

from.description: The first date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: The count of questions of a page, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

member.description: A name of the member, in Georgian: the family name, or the family name and the first name.

page.description: The page, from 1. The default is 1.

query.description: A text of the request, in Georgian, 1 to 128 characters.

to.description: The last date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: parliament_search_questions

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the data, RFC 3339.

notice.description: Set when a text with no Georgian letter found nothing.

page.description: The page of this answer, from 1.

questions.description: The questions of the page, newest first.

addressee.description: The body and the person that the question goes to.

deadline.description: The last day of the answer, YYYY-MM-DD.

request.description: The request, as the Parliament summarizes it.

responded.description: The day of the answer, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The page of the question, with the files of the question and the answer.

source.description: The source of the data: Parliament of Georgia.

stale.description: True when the Parliament did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

total.description: The count of all the matches at the source.

title: Search the questions of the members of the Parliament of Georgia
